run_role: preflight grading diagnosis; not part of the final three-run baseline

diagnosis.classification: grading false negatives; benchmark content and answer were coherent
examples: The answer said IndexedDB blobs are used otherwise; the matcher required the literal word fallback.
The answer said client UUIDs provide create idempotency; the matcher required uuid plus idempotent.
The answer described optimistic version checks in the architecture section; the matcher also required the word conflict there.
The answer used plain UTF-8 and screen-reader announcements; the matcher did not allow UTF-8 as a plain-text representation.
The answer listed app launch, pull to refresh, and online local edits; the matcher unnecessarily required websocket to pass that current-trigger fact.
diagnosis.decision: Do not run Mode B. Keep the same propositions, criticality, and 90% pass threshold; revise only acceptable synonymous representations and freeze methodology v2 before the final A runs.
